name: Varun Beverages Ltd.
business_summary: One of the world's largest PepsiCo bottlers: Pepsi, 7UP, Mirinda, Mountain Dew, Tropicana, Gatorade, Aquafina in India (about 80%+ of sales) plus Nepal, Sri Lanka, Morocco, Zambia, Zimbabwe, DRC and South Africa. Calendar-year company; strongly seasonal (Q1/Q2 peak, Q4 trough). TTM sales Rs 16,454 cr, EBITDA Rs 4,294 cr (26%), PAT Rs 3,032 cr; almost debt free (interest Rs 29 cr). September-2026 quarter (Q3 CY26): screener sales Rs 3,822 cr (+25% y/y), OPM 24% vs 26%, PAT Rs 659 cr (+14%); media reported +33% revenue growth and PAT Rs 828 cr on a different basis, so the consolidation basis is unverified. Promoters 59.43%; FIIs 19.5% -> 17.5% in two quarters.

revenue_mix.segment: juices and non-carbonated (Tropicana, Slice, Gatorade, Sting)
packaged drinking water, dairy beverages, other

exposures.mechanism: Sugar ~14% of costs = Rs 1,702 cr on cost base Rs 12,160 cr; +10% -> Rs 170 cr = 4.0% of EBITDA (Rs 4,294 cr). Fixed consumer price points limit pass-through (50% unrecovered), persistence 0.35, EV/MCap 1.0 => -0.7. Sugar is +27.8% since June (2.8 SSU) and +18.6% in 3m, so the 24% Sep-quarter margin vs 26% is partly this (Moneycontrol 2026-10-30: margins contract).
